description:
Join a team that is modernizing the future of air traffic management while supporting one of the nation’s most critical missions. In this role, you’ll contribute to the development and deployment of the FAA’s Terminal Flight Data Manager (TFDM) system, helping deliver NextGen capabilities that improve the safety, efficiency, and reliability of the National Airspace System. Beyond software development, you’ll have the unique opportunity to work directly with FAA customers at airport locations across the country, supporting system deployments and seeing firsthand how your work enables mission success. If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, collaborating with customers, and making a tangible impact in operational environments, this role offers an exceptional opportunity to grow your career while supporting a program of national importance. 
 Leidos is looking for a Software Developer focusing on System Management supporting our Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Terminal Flight Data Manager (TFDM) program. 
 
 The successful candidate will play a crucial role in ensuring the seamless integration and functionality of next-generation air traffic management systems. Your expertise will directly contribute to the modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS), helping deliver technology that improves the safety and efficiency of air traffic operations at airports nationwide.
 TFDM is the surface management solution that will provide NextGen Air Traffic Control capabilities to improve air traffic operations in the National Airspace System (NAS). The TFDM program is a Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) NextGen initiative focused on airport surface management, delivering a comprehensive integrated surface traffic control and management system that enhances efficiency for both airport surface operations and terminal airspace. Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
 Location: This position is based in our Egg Harbor Township, NJ office with a hybrid schedule of 3 days per week in the office and 2 days working remotely.
 Travel: Up to 50% travel is required for this role and is one of its most exciting aspects. You'll have the opportunity to travel to FAA airport locations across the United States, working side-by-side with customers and field teams as the TFDM system is deployed to 89 airports nationwide. This hands-on experience provides a unique chance to see your work come to life in operational environments, collaborate directly with FAA personnel, and gain firsthand insight into the technology that supports the nation's air traffic system. Travel is typically 1–2 weeks per trip, offering a rewarding balance of customer engagement, real-world system implementation, and technical problem solving.
 
 Technical Skills (Required) 
   Core Technologies:
 Ansible - Deep experience with playbooks, roles, custom plugins, callbacks, and inventory systems

 Python - Strong scripting, automation, and tool development

 Bash/Shell scripting - Complex build orchestration and system automation

 Linux system administration – Red Hat Enterprise Linux, package management, integration of Linux technologies, etc. Demands strong foundational Linux administration and management of the full lifecycle of systems from bare metal to operational deployment across multiple environments.

 Container technology - Podman/Docker, container builds, orchestration

   Infrastructure & DevOps:
 Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices

 Configuration management at scale

 CI/CD and build automation

 Release management and versioning

 Git workflows and collaboration

   Systems Knowledge:
 Network configuration (VLANs, IP schemes, switch configs)

 Physical hardware provisioning (PXE boot, kickstart)

 Virtual machine lifecycle management (VMware and KVM)

 Multi-environment deployment (dev/test/prod/lab)

 Package ecosystem management (RPM, pip, Ansible Galaxy)

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field
 4+ years of proven experience in Software Engineering
 
 Technical Skills (Highly Desirable) 
 Ansible best practices

 YAML templating and variable hierarchies

 Ansible vault and secrets management

 Multi-site infrastructure coordination

 Custom Ansible plugin development

 AI assisted development

 
 Domain Experience 
 Enterprise infrastructure management

 Mission-critical system deployment

 Multi-processor-type system architectures

 Air-gapped or classified environments

 
 Qualities & Soft Skills 
   Systems Thinking:
 Understand complex interdependencies (200+ Ansible roles, multiple processor types)

 Trace issues across numerous environment configurations

 See how changes ripple through the architecture

   Systematic & Methodical:
 Follow documented workflows (TCM verification, CAS validation)

 Test thoroughly before deployment

   Problem-Solving Approach:
 Debug across multiple abstraction layers

 Work within constraints of existing architecture

   Collaboration:
 Work with established patterns rather than reinventing

 Coordinate across multiple sites and environments
